ideas.idea: Add address, directions and hours as visible text on the Visit page, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The visit page says 'Opening times and directions' but the body has no directions, so this is a real content gap in the repo.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness structured data to the Visit page once the details are visible
ideas.why: It is optional and hedged, and JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Expand the Varieties page with a list and a separate page and URL for each variety
ideas.why: The page names only two of 'over forty' varieties, so per-variety pages would add real content and crawlable URLs.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap if real update dates exist
ideas.why: It is accurate, because the sitemap has no lastmod, but it is standard advice with little effect on a three-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Link to Varieties and Visit from the home page body, not just the nav
ideas.why: It is accurate, but the nav already links every page on a three-page site, so the effect is small.
